files.extent: Complete pinned opcode table retrieved; semantic notes concern opcode-to-handler dispatch and end sentinel, not every command's behavior.
source_observations: The table is an ordered .4byte vector of ScrCmd_* handlers indexed by the script opcode byte; gScriptCmdTableEnd follows the final entry as a separate end marker.
The table's ordered mapping is an ABI with command emitters and bytecode readers; changing an entry or ordering changes behavior even when map-table layout is unchanged.

files.extent: Complete pinned file retrieved and its bytes rehashed to the expected Git blob and SHA-256; bounded behavior review only for map-script-relevant command handlers.
source_observations: ScrCmd_goto and ScrCmd_call read 32-bit pointer operands bytewise via ScriptReadWord, then delegate control-flow changes to ScriptJump or ScriptCall.
ScrCmd_goto_if and ScrCmd_call_if read a condition byte and a pointer operand, then use sScriptConditionTable and comparisonResult to decide whether to transfer control.
Other pointer-bearing commands such as loadword and setptr also consume 32-bit operands; their meanings and bounds depend on emitted script bytes and caller conventions.
This file contains many unrelated command implementations; their full behavior and every callee contract are not reviewed here.
